assets.name: bundle-snail
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: corrected 2D game death key-pose source sheet. Image 1 is the edit target. Keep its transparent 2x2 sheet layout, all four equal cell sizes, character pixel scale, rendering style, palette, outline, left-facing camera, rigid golden spiral shell, cargo and OPEN-BOTTOM shell architecture. Keep the neutral top-left pose and empty-shell bottom-right endpoint. REPLACE the incorrect soft-body motion in the TOP-RIGHT and BOTTOM-LEFT cells. The user wants a SIMPLE HORIZONTAL SHORTENING of the soft body, with NO CURLING whatsoever. The mint-ivory body stays low on the SAME horizontal ground baseline, with approximately its original vertical thickness. Its front end/head slides straight RIGHT toward the shell center and its tail slides straight LEFT toward the shell center. The body is progressively SHORTER IN X ONLY. Visually it should look like the original body silhouette being compressed horizontally beneath its shell, not a neck folding back. Do not make an upward-rearing head, bent-back neck, folded muscle, rising lump, arched back, curled tongue, coiled worm, C-shape, J-shape, S-shape, thick rolled fold, wrinkles, or a detached blob. The head must not tuck its chin or turn around. Preserve the original soft body's simple smooth surface. TOP LEFT: retain original neutral full-length body, upright eyestalks, round dark eyes. TOP RIGHT: early contraction, the whole soft foot/head is approximately 65 percent of its initial left-right length, shortened toward a fixed center beneath the shell. Both front and rear ends have moved horizontally inward. Its smooth upper/lower contour has the same y-level and thickness as neutral, and the foot underside remains at exactly the same ground level. Eyestalks have retracted into small smooth nubs, but the head is simply a narrower forward-facing rounded head, NOT a folded head. No extra front fold, double chin, neck wrinkles or foot curling. The shell and cargo retain neutral location and size. BOTTOM LEFT: late contraction, only approximately 25 percent of the original soft body's horizontal length remains as a SHORT LOW MINT PAD directly under the center of the shell. Its front and tail ends are now nearly underneath the shell, with only small slivers visible below the lower rim and at the open lower-front mouth. No vertical bulge or upright white muscle standing in the aperture. The body has shortened smoothly and stays level; do not depict a curl or head shape at this stage. Keep a little of the same original foot thickness supporting the shell. Shell/cargo still rigid and level. BOTTOM RIGHT: retain fully empty open-bottom shell endpoint, after the body has contracted completely inward; shell alone has lowered slightly onto the original ground baseline, with empty lower-front cavity and open underside clearly visible. No white body outside. Only the SOFT BODY shortens in X. Never squeeze or rescale the entire creature, the shell, spiral or cargo. Match shell diameter, spiral position, and cargo silhouette between cells; no arbitrary root drift. Actual production key drawings with genuine transparency, fully visible unclipped characters. No labels, text, grid lines, scenery, floor, cast shadows, motion lines, ghosting, fades, or diagrams. Identity lock: SMALL BUNDLE SNAIL, same leaf wrapping, green strap, two tan mushrooms and three red berries. Preserve the small round golden spiral shell and all existing cargo.
